overview: DevKit CLI is a single-binary command-line toolkit that bundles six everyday developer utilities—formatting helpers, file conversions, and quick checks—into one download. It runs on Node 18+ with zero external dependencies, so you can drop it into any project or machine without installing a dependency tree. Built for developers who want small, predictable chores handled fast without context-switching to web tools.
usecases: Converting a JSON payload to YAML while debugging an API response on a flight with no internet.
Batch-renaming and linting a folder of config files before committing a pull request.
Generating a quick hash or UUID during local testing without opening a browser tab.
howto: Download the appbundle and extract it to a folder on your machine.
Add the extracted binary to your PATH or run it directly with node devkit.js.
Run `devkit --help` to list the six utilities and start using one.

faq.q: Does it replace my existing toolchain?
faq.a: No—it covers small chores; keep your linters and formatters for project-specific rules.

faq.q: Is it free of dependencies at runtime?
faq.a: Yes, it ships with zero npm dependencies and only requires Node 18+.
